name: Conviction, Communal
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 2

EFFECT

Target creatures touched

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like conviction except you divide the duration in 1-minute intervals among the creatures touched.
